segments.en: Through deep contemplation on the secrets of the Torah, one can bring conception to barren women and heal a serious illness.

segments.he:
א.

עַל-יְדֵי עִיוּן עָמֹק בְּסוֹדוֹת הַתּוֹרָה יוּכַל לִפְקֹד עֲקָרוֹת וּלְרַפְּאוֹת חוֹלַאַת חָזָק.
segments.en: Through deep contemplation on the secrets of the Torah, one can bring conception to barren women and heal a serious illness.
